Container.Name: Kokoro-FastAPI-GPU
Container.Overview:
Kokoro-FastAPI serves the Kokoro-82M text-to-speech model behind an OpenAI-compatible speech API (/v1/audio/speech), accelerated on an NVIDIA GPU. It is fast and natural sounding, supports English, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, French, Hindi, Italian and Portuguese voices, voice mixing, streaming, timestamps and SSML, and includes a web player at /web. Models are baked into the image.
**Requirements**
- The **Nvidia Driver** plugin. Pick your GPU with NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES (all, or a GPU UUID from the plugin page). - GTX 900-series through RTX 40-series: use the default `:latest` tag. **RTX 50-series (Blackwell):** change the repository to `ghcr.io/remsky/kokoro-fastapi-gpu:latest-cu128`. Upstream recommends pinning a release tag (e.g. `:v0.4.x`) for stable use. No NVIDIA GPU: use `ghcr.io/remsky/kokoro-fastapi-cpu:latest` instead.
**Home Assistant**
Install the **OpenAI TTS** integration from HACS (https://github.com/sfortis/openai_tts), choose the **Kokoro-FastAPI** preset and set the URL to `http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:8880/v1/audio/speech` (the preset fills in localhost). The voice list is read from the server. Wyoming users can use wyoming_openai instead. Open WebUI, SillyTavern and other OpenAI-compatible clients work with base URL `http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:8880/v1`.
**Notes**
- The API has no authentication by default. Set API Keys (a JSON list) if the port is reachable beyond your LAN; the built-in web player still loads but sends no key, so it can no longer generate audio. - The container runs as UID 1001. The optional download-links folder must be writable by it: `mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/kokoro-tts/temp` then `chown 1001:1001 /mnt/user/appdata/kokoro-tts/temp`. - All variables: https://github.com/remsky/Kokoro-FastAPI/blob/master/docs/configuration.md

Config.Name: WebUI / API Port
Config.Description: Web player at /web, API at /v1, docs at /docs.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Visible Devices
Config.Description: GPU UUID to use (from the Nvidia Driver plugin page) or all.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Driver Capabilities
Config.Description: Driver features exposed to the container. compute,utility is enough for inference.

Config.Name: Default Voice
Config.Description: Voice used when a request names none; also preselected in the web player. Mixes like af_bella+af_sky work.

Config.Name: API Keys
Config.Description: JSON list of accepted keys, e.g. ["key-one","key-two"]. [] = no authentication. When set, API and websocket routes need Authorization: Bearer KEY; /health and the docs stay open. Never leave it empty, which stops the server.

Config.Name: Download Links Folder
Config.Description: Optional. Audio files created with return_download_link. Must be writable by UID 1001 (see Overview).

Config.Name: Use GPU
Config.Description: Use the GPU when one is available.

Config.Name: Device Type
Config.Description: Force the device: cuda or cpu. Leave empty to auto-detect.

Config.Name: Idle Unload (seconds)
Config.Description: Unload the model from VRAM after this many idle seconds; 0 keeps it loaded.

Config.Name: CORS Origins
Config.Description: JSON list of allowed browser origins. Narrow it if the port is reachable beyond your LAN.

Config.Name: Workers
Config.Description: uvicorn worker processes. Each loads its own model copy into VRAM.
